Report this job Direct message the job poster from Quantum Integrators Vibha Patel Vibha Patel IT Recruiter || Talent Acquisition || LinkedIn Open Networker (LION) || Connecting Talent Opportunities Position - Senior Spotfire Developer (Clinical Data Analytics & Visualization) Location – Pune/Nagpur Duration – Full time with Quantum Timing – UK Shift (02.00 PM to 11.00 PM IST) Role Summary: We are seeking an experienced Spotfire Developer with strong expertise in clinical trial and patient data visualization , Spotfire dashboard development, and integration with modern web applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building scalable analytics solutions for clinical data review, monitoring, and reporting platforms while supporting Spotfire administration activities and integrating Spotfire with diverse enterprise data sources, preferably Databricks. Experience with embedded analytics, React/UI integration, and life sciences data domains is strongly preferred. Required Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Life Sciences, or related field. 8-10 years of total expereince which includes 5+ years of Spotfire development experience. 3+ years working with clinical trial or healthcare data. Strong experience developing complex Spotfire dashboards and analytical applications. Experience connecting Spotfire to multiple structured and semi-structured data sources. Hands-on experience with SQL and data modeling. Experience with Spotfire Administration and platform support. Knowledge of clinical data domains and standards. Key Responsibilities: Spotfire Development & Visualization: Design, develop, and maintain interactive Spotfire dashboards and analytical applications for clinical trial data review and patient monitoring. Create reusable visualizations, custom expressions, calculated measures, data functions, and advanced analytics workflows. Optimize dashboard performance for large-scale clinical datasets. Support patient-level, study-level, and cross-study reporting use cases. Clinical Data Analytics: Develop visualizations and reporting solutions using clinical data standards including: SDTM ADaM EDC/Rave data Safety and medical review datasets Central and risk-based monitoring data Partner with Clinical Programming, Data Management, Medical Monitoring, and Clinical Operations stakeholders to translate business requirements into analytics solutions. Spotfire Embedded Analytics & UI Integration: Integrate Spotfire visualizations into custom web applications using Spotfire APIs and JavaScript APIs. Collaborate with React/UI development teams to implement seamless embedded analytics experiences. Support authentication, authorization, and single sign-on integrations. Develop custom interactions between Spotfire dashboards and external applications. Data Integration: Connect Spotfire to diverse enterprise data sources, including: Databricks (preferred) PostgreSQL SQL Server Oracle Snowflake REST APIs Cloud-based data platforms Design efficient data access patterns and optimize query performance. Support migration from legacy reporting solutions to modern cloud-based data architectures. Spotfire Administration & Platform Support: Support Spotfire platform administration activities including: User and group management Library administration Access controls and permissions Deployment and migration activities Monitoring and troubleshooting Work with enterprise Spotfire administration teams on upgrades, security updates, and platform governance. Assist in environment management across DEV, QA, PRE-PROD, and PROD environments. Quality & Compliance: Support regulated/GxP environments and software development lifecycle activities. Contribute to documentation, validation artifacts, testing, and release management. Follow enterprise security, audit, and compliance requirements. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Databricks Lakehouse architecture . Experience embedding Spotfire within React, Angular, or other modern web frameworks. Experience with Spotfire JavaScript API and Web Player integration. Experience supporting cloud-based clinical analytics platforms leveraging Spotfire and Databricks components. Familiarity with AWS and cloud-native architectures. Experience supporting centralized monitoring and clinical data review platforms. Knowledge of AI/ML-enabled analytics solutions. Experience in GxP-regulated pharmaceutical environments. Technical Skills: Required: TIBCO Spotfire SQL Data Visualization & Analytics Data Modeling Spotfire Information Links Spotfire Data Functions Clinical Reporting Preferred: Databricks PySpark Python React JavaScript / TypeScript REST APIs AWS PostgreSQL Azure DevOps / Jira Git Ideal Candidate Profile: The successful candidate combines: Deep Spotfire dashboard development expertise Clinical trial and patient data reporting experience Embedded analytics and UI integration skills Working knowledge of Spotfire administration Strong Databricks and cloud data platform experience Ability to engage directly with business stakeholders and translate clinical review needs into scalable analytics solutions Regards Vibha Patel vibha.patel@quantumintegrators.com Show more Show less Seniority level Mid-Senior level Employment type Full-time Job function Other Industries IT Services and IT Consulting Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Quantum Integrators by 2x See who you know

Report this job Direct message the job poster from Evernorth Health Services SHAIK KHAJA MOHINUDDIN SHAIK KHAJA MOHINUDDIN -- ABOUT EVERNORTH: Evernorth℠ exists to elevate health for all, because we believe health is the starting point for human potential and progress. As champions for affordable, predictable and simple health care, we solve the problems others don’t, won’t or can’t. Our innovation hub in India will allow us to work with the right talent, expand our global footprint, improve our competitive stance, and better deliver on our promises to stakeholders. We are passionate about making healthcare better by delivering world-class solutions that make a real difference. We are always looking upward. And that starts with finding the right talent to help us get there. Excited to grow your career? We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply! Our people make all the difference in our success. We are looking for engineer to develop, optimize and fine-tune AI models for performance, scalability, and accuracy. In this role you will support the full software lifecycle of design, development, testing, and support for technical delivery. This role requires working with both onsite and offshore team members in properly defining testable scenarios based on requirements/acceptance criteria. Position Overview Develop and support software that collects, transforms, and sends medical determination data to clients’ medical claims systems. Most work centers on MS SQL Server—, T-SQL, data quality, and troubleshooting—in support of integrations and operational reliability. Hands-on .NET is required to support services and UIs and grow into fuller application delivery over time, including alignment or partnership with teams that own broader apps and APIs. You will collaborate with senior engineers and architects on design, own well-scoped features, and contribute to quality, maintainability, and team practices while learning the domain. Responsibilities Technical 5 years professional software development experience (or equivalent depth); solid record shipping work in Agile/iterative delivery. Strong hands-on MS SQL Server (4+ years practical use): T-SQL for features, integrations, and operational support; reading execution plans, indexing fundamentals, and improving slow or complex queries (with support on advanced tuning). Schema design awareness: tables, keys, constraints, and tradeoffs with reporting or downstream consumers; ability to align database design with Entity Framework models and migrations where the stack uses them. Experience debugging data issues: tracing inconsistencies, reconciliation, and connecting application errors to the database; familiarity with team patterns for stored procedures, views, and/or functions as applicable. 4+ years hands-on .NET (.NET Framework and/or .NET as defined by the team); C# (VB.NET if the codebase requires it; otherwise, nice-to-have). ASP.NET Web API / REST and ASP.NET MVC with Razor and/or comparable server-side UI patterns in use. Entity Framework: modeling, migrations, LINQ; room to deepen performance work over time. Web applications plus APIs; exposure to microservices or distributed systems (hands-on or supported). Cloud, platform & operations Azure fundamentals: deploy/debug apps, configuration, basic monitoring. Familiarity with Application Insights (or similar APM/logging), including correlating issues with database behavior when helpful. Exposure to CI/CD (e.g. Azure DevOps) and Jira (or similar) for delivery tracking. Preferred: Kafka/pub-sub, CAI- with Terraform, Service Fabric. Qualifications Required Skills: Strong experience in C#, SOLID Design Principles/Patterns, OOP, Data Structures, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET Web API, ReactJS, xUnit, TDD, Kafka, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture, Azure (including Terraforms and AKS), Cosmos DB Knowledge of Service Oriented Architecture, SonarQube, CheckMarx Ability to speak/write fluently in English Experience with agile methodology including SCRUM. Experience with modern delivery practices such as continuous integration, behavior/test driven development, and specification by example. Required Experience & Education: Software engineer (with 3-5 years of overall experience) with at-least 3 years in the key skills listed above Bachelor’s degree equivalent in Information Technology, Business Information Systems, Technology Management, or related field of study. Report this job Role: SDE-2/ SDE-3 (Full Stack Engineer, Hyperlocal Engineering) Location: Bengaluru /Chennai Experience: 4 to 8 years   About LoadShare  LoadShare is one of India's most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we've grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.  What sets us apart Scale with depth: We handle -550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network. Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability. Dual-engine model: We not only operate India's most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day, one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals. Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize delivery partners across different earning opportunities, matching the peaks of various use-cases through the day (grocery peaks at 6-8 am, bike taxi from 8 to 10 am, and so on). In addition, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day. Strategic partner to India's digital economy : We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility), and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands. Built to scale profitably : We're not chasing GMV at all costs. We're building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We're now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines. Founders/ Founding team:  Raghu Talluri (CEO) — formerly at Myntra, McKinsey  Pramod Nair (CTO) — formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi  Rakib Ahmed (Co-founder, Head of Ecomm /Trucking /Warehousing) — formerly at ICICI Prudential, co- founder Lunate Eco   About the Role  The Hyperlocal Engineering team owns hyperlocal and quick commerce at LoadShare We work with the largest commerce platforms in the country, at volumes where the delivery promise is measured in minutes. The problems are real ones: real-time assignment at scale, delivery time prediction, and systems that hold up when demand triples in twenty minutes. Last mile in India is not a solved problem, and we work on it in production, at volume. We are hiring engineers who can own services in this stack end to end. Not just ship features, but understand the system deeply and the business it serves. Must-Have  4 to 8 years of professional full stack engineering experience, with strong backend engineering skil Is (Java, Python) and frontend development experience (React or React Native).  Proven experience with relational databases at scale, including query optimisation, index design, and diagnosing performance regressions in production.  Working knowledge of Redis, message queues (SQS, Kafka, or equivalent), and asynchronous processing patterns.  Hands-on experience with AWS in production.  Solid grasp of distributed systems basics: idempotency, retries, concurrency, eventual consistency, and the failure modes that come with them.  Strong production troubleshooting skills, with experience owning issues through to root cause.  Strong business understanding, with the ability to make engineering decisions grounded in business outcomes rather than requirements alone.  Al-native working style, with hands-on experience using coding agents and LLM tooling in day to day engineering work.  Good-to-Have  Prior experience in logistics, quick commerce, or on-demand delivery platforms. Experience building or extending Al agents, MCP tooling, or internal developer platforms.  Experience working in a high-growth environment with evolving requirements. Why This Role  Real problems at scale- Last mile delivery at this volume is one of the harder engineering problems in India.  Breadth- Work across backend, frontend, and data, on systems that run the business. Business proximity - See the effect of your work in operational metrics within days, not quarters.  Al-native by default- We engineer with Al across the lifecycle, and you will help shape how.  Growth stage- We are scaling toward the next phase as a company, with scope to grow into   Show more Show less Seniority level Not Applicable Employment type Full-time Job function Engineering and Information Technology Industries Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at LoadShare Networks by 2x See who you know
